name: manage-project
description: Take a project from a loose conversation to a reviewed build: plan it in one PLAN.md, build it milestone by milestone, review it and retire it, each stage on the right model, settling questions from precedent and keeping private data and credentials safe, with the git and Markdown conventions any repo needs.

guard.title: Guard hook
guard.description: on (the default): the guard hook asks you before an action that cannot be taken back, and refuses it when nobody is present (secure-project, Enforce the hard rules with the guard hook); off: it asks nothing in a session you attend, while a run with nobody present stays guarded.
